description_en: Removes an authorization from an account in a resource directory
description_zh: 调用DeleteAccessAssignment移除RD账号上的授权
kebab_example: aliyun cloudsso delete-access-assignment --directory-id d-00fc2p610000 --access-configuration-id ac-00jhtfl8thteu6uj0000 --target-type RD-Account --target-id 1142405247840000 --principal-type User --principal-id u-00q8wbq42wiltcrk0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DeleteAccessAssignment

parameters.help_en: The task target type. Valid values: RD-Account, which specifies that the task target type is an account in a resource directory
parameters.help_zh: 任务目标类型。取值：RD-Account，表示任务目标类型为RD账号
parameters.name: target_type

parameters.help_en:
The CloudSSO identity type. Valid values:

User: user.
Group: group
parameters.help_zh:
云SSO身份类型。取值：

User：用户。
Group：用户组
parameters.name: principal_type

parameters.help_en:
The CloudSSO identity ID. Details:

If `PrincipalType` is set to `User`, `PrincipalId` is the CloudSSO user ID.
If `PrincipalType` is set to `Group`, `PrincipalId` is the CloudSSO group ID
parameters.help_zh:
云SSO身份ID。具体如下：

当`PrincipalType`为`User`时，`PrincipalId`为云SSO用户ID。
当`PrincipalType`为`Group`时，`PrincipalId`为云SSO用户组ID
parameters.name: principal_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to also cancel the access configuration provisioning when you remove the last authorization that uses the access configuration from an account in a resource directory. Valid values:

DeprovisionForLastAccessAssignmentOnAccount: cancels the access configuration provisioning.
None (default): does not cancel the access configuration provisioning
parameters.help_zh:
当您移除一个RD账号上使用某访问配置的最后一个授权时，是否同时解除访问配置部署。取值：

DeprovisionForLastAccessAssignmentOnAccount：解除访问配置部署。
None（默认值）：不解除访问配置部署
parameters.name: deprovision_strategy

PrincipalType.description_en:
The CloudSSO identity type. Valid values:

User: user.
Group: group
PrincipalType.description_zh:
云SSO身份类型。取值：

User：用户。
Group：用户组

Status.description_en:
The task status. Valid values:

InProgress: The task is in progress.
Success: The task succeeded.
Failed: The task failed
Status.description_zh:
任务状态。取值：

InProgress：任务执行中。
Success：任务执行成功。
Failed：任务执行失败

TargetPath.description_en: The path ID of the task target in the resource directory
TargetPath.description_zh: 任务目标在资源目录中的路径ID

TargetPathName.description_en: The path name of the task target in the resource directory
TargetPathName.description_zh: 任务目标在资源目录中的路径名称

TargetType.description_en: The task target type. Valid values: RD-Account, which specifies that the task target type is an account in a resource directory
TargetType.description_zh: 任务目标类型。取值：RD-Account，表示任务目标类型为RD账号

TaskType.description_en: The task type. Valid values: DeleteAccessAssignment, which indicates a task that removes an authorization from an account in a resource directory
TaskType.description_zh: 任务类型。取值：DeleteAccessAssignment，表示移除RD账号上的授权任务
